name: @dreamfactory/skullcracker
description: Skull Cracker (1996) — CyberFlix's own, and the one game here with no BOOTFILE and no script: its logic is compiled into the executable and read back out with a disassembler rather than interpreted. Experimental; its own version because it would release on its own tag.
//scripts: Run from anywhere with `-w skullcracker`; npm sets the working directory to this package, which is why every path here is relative to it and `vite`/`vitest` find the configs beside this file with no --config.
